views.name: analytics.hiv_observation_fact_v1
views.grain: Demo-only HIV care observation fact at exactly one row per FHIR Observation, pivoting each coding system (CIEL / SNOMED / WHO-ANC) into its own column from the lossless observation_flat base. concept_name comes from the OpenMRS-native coding's display. A row carries a numeric, coded, text, boolean, or datetime value depending on the concept. Dataset notes: HIV viral load has only 3 recorded results in this instance (CD4 count and CD4% are the well-populated quantitative markers), and HIV status is not recorded as a Condition — questions about patients with HIV or on treatment must use the Antiretroviral plan/use or Current WHO HIV stage concepts.

columns.name: observation_id
columns.description: FHIR Observation resource identifier and stable row identity.

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: FHIR Patient resource identifier referenced by the observation.

columns.name: encounter_id
columns.description: FHIR Encounter resource identifier the observation was recorded within.

columns.name: patient_gender
columns.description: FHIR Patient.gender.

columns.name: patient_birth_date
columns.description: FHIR Patient.birthDate. Compute age at observation as (observed_at - patient_birth_date) rather than assuming a stored age column.

columns.name: obs_status
columns.description: FHIR Observation.status.

columns.name: observed_at
columns.description: FHIR Observation effective dateTime.

columns.name: concept_name
columns.description: Human-readable concept display name from the OpenMRS-native coding; populated on every row regardless of which terminology mappings exist. This is the reliable way to select a concept: a question naming a marker must constrain this field.

columns.name: concept_code_ciel
columns.description: CIEL numeric code for the observed concept (e.g. 5497 for CD4 count). Coverage verified against the complete dataset: 99.9% of observations carry a CIEL coding; a small residue does not, so concept_name (which is populated on every row and carries the semantic aliases) remains the primary way to select a concept, with this column for terminology filtering and cross-reference.

columns.name: concept_code_snomed
columns.description: SNOMED CT code for the observed concept when the source carries a SNOMED coding. Cross-reference/terminology column; coverage is partial, as with CIEL.

columns.name: concept_code_who_anc
columns.description: WHO ANC custom code (http://fhir.org/guides/who/anc-cds) for the observed concept when present. Cross-reference/terminology column; sparse.

columns.name: value_numeric
columns.description: Populated only for numeric-valued concepts (e.g. CD4 count, CD4%, CD8 count). Null for coded, text, boolean, or datetime observations; do not aggregate across unlike concepts or units.

columns.name: value_unit
columns.description: Unit for value_numeric, when the source Observation carries one.

columns.name: value_coded_name
columns.description: Human-readable label for a coded answer (e.g. Yes/No/Unknown for antiretroviral use, a WHO stage, an adherence category), from the OpenMRS-native coding; populated for every coded-valued observation.

columns.name: value_coded_code_ciel
columns.description: CIEL numeric code for the coded answer when the source carries one; near-complete coverage, same residue caveat as concept_code_ciel. value_coded_name is populated on every coded row.

columns.name: value_coded_code_snomed
columns.description: SNOMED CT code for the coded answer when the source carries one; cross-reference column.

columns.name: value_text
columns.description: Free-text value, for the small number of concepts recorded as plain text.

columns.name: value_boolean
columns.description: Boolean value, for yes/no concepts recorded as FHIR valueBoolean (e.g. screening flags).

columns.name: value_datetime
columns.description: Datetime value, for concepts recorded as FHIR valueDateTime (e.g. return-visit or event dates).

views.name: analytics.hiv_visit_fact_v1
views.grain: Demo-only HIV care visit fact at exactly one row per FHIR Encounter (collapsing the type/participant/location coding cross product). days_since_prior_visit is computed across this view's own 2020-2035 window, so a query that further narrows started_at still sees the real gap; it is null only for a patient's first encounter inside the window.

columns.name: encounter_id
columns.description: FHIR Encounter resource identifier and stable row identity.

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: FHIR Patient resource identifier referenced by the encounter.

columns.name: patient_gender
columns.description: FHIR Patient.gender.

columns.name: patient_birth_date
columns.description: FHIR Patient.birthDate.

columns.name: encounter_status
columns.description: FHIR Encounter.status.

columns.name: encounter_type
columns.description: FHIR Encounter type display name; almost all encounters in this demo instance are OPD Visit.

columns.name: started_at
columns.description: FHIR Encounter.period.start.

columns.name: ended_at
columns.description: FHIR Encounter.period.end.

columns.name: prior_visit_started_at
columns.description: started_at of this patient's immediately preceding visit in this view; null for a patient's first visit in the 2020-2035 window.

columns.name: days_since_prior_visit
columns.description: Days between this visit and the patient's immediately preceding visit. Real, patient-specific spacing (some patients visit monthly with gaps, some have single-day visit pairs); it is not a fixed or uniform interval. Null for a patient's first visit.

views.name: analytics.hiv_concept_mapping_v1
views.grain: Terminology-mapping coverage observed in the data: one row per distinct (concept, OpenMRS/CIEL/SNOMED/WHO-ANC code) combination with the number of observations carrying it. Null in a code column means that observation batch carried no coding from that system.

columns.name: concept_name
columns.description: Human-readable concept display name from the OpenMRS-native coding.

columns.name: openmrs_concept_code
columns.description: OpenMRS-native concept code (UUID-form, no system URI in the source).

columns.name: ciel_code
columns.description: CIEL numeric code mapped to this concept, when the observations carried one; null means those observations had no CIEL mapping.

columns.name: snomed_code
columns.description: SNOMED CT code mapped to this concept, when present.

columns.name: who_anc_code
columns.description: WHO ANC custom code mapped to this concept, when present.

columns.name: observation_count
columns.description: Number of observations carrying exactly this mapping combination.
